subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Summer BBQ
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual summer BBQ will be held on Friday, July 30th at the company's rooftop garden. Join us for a fun-filled evening with delicious food, games, and great company. Please RSVP by July 15th to ensure we have enough food and drinks for everyone. We look forward to celebrating with you all! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
